cellDecisions.nonEquivalence: Does not mean the manufacturer equals operator, data publisher, station owner or physical unit identifier; DIRECT is a project comparison, not a formal published equivalence assertion.

cellDecisions.semanticBasis: The existing donor comparison explicitly distinguishes an addressable IEEE TransducerChannel from a CSAPI DataStream, which groups/report-delivers dynamic data. The tempting one-to-one equivalence is rejected.
cellDecisions.nonEquivalence: A DataStream is not a physical transducer, its address, or a standalone channel. Do not populate the CSAPI cell in the 'Addressed transducer channel' row based only on the DataStream existence; retain its appropriate reporting meaning in a different row.
